questions.prompt: A flush draw on the flop has how many outs to the flush, if no pair outs are counted?
questions.explanation: There are 13 cards of the suit and you already see 4, so 9 remain.

questions.prompt: An open-ended straight draw on the flop has…
questions.explanation: Four cards on each end complete the straight, so eight outs.

questions.prompt: The rule of 2 and 4 says a 9-out draw has about…

choices.text: 9% on the flop to the river.
About 36% from the flop to the river, and about 18% with one card to come.

questions.explanation: Multiply outs by 4 with two cards to come, or by 2 with one. 9×4=36, 9×2=18.

questions.prompt: Equity is not the same as realization because…

choices.text: Outs are always paid in full.
Position and future bets do not matter.
You may not get to see all the cards, or you may win extra when you hit.

questions.explanation: Fold equity, position, and stacks change how much of your raw equity you keep.
